initial_public_ci.causal_limit: Controlled SQLite contention reproduces the surfaced failure mode; the exact original CI cause is unproven.

boundaries: Proof deadlines start with request preparation and include existing accounting headroom; frames never reset them.
Shutdown can shorten the deadline; pending actual workers remain owned after waiter cancellation.
Native bytes wait for durable proof; unknown source liability is retained without replay.
Final public CI and protected-main release authorization remain separate gates.

publication.redactions: Private artifact locations and fingerprints, process identifiers and observed correlation values are omitted or aliased. Numerical results and useful public source/version references are retained.
publication.original_records: Unmodified operational records and original hashes are retained privately; this derivative is not a raw capture.
